name: charity-check
description: Look up a US nonprofit's IRS filings, multi-year financials and computed ratios.

interface.longDescription:
Check a US nonprofit's tax-exempt status, revenue, expenses and officer pay before you donate, award a grant or join a board, using live IRS Form 990 data from ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer.

Search by name (optionally in one state or one category) to find the organization's EIN. The profile shows the IRS facts (501(c) subsection, foundation status, deductibility, exemption status, ruling date) and a multi-year table of total revenue, total expenses, net assets, total assets and officer compensation for each tax year on file, with the form type (990, 990-EZ or 990-PF), year-over-year change and links to the filing PDFs. Ratios are computed from the filed figures and each one comes with its formula: surplus margin, contributions share of revenue, officer pay share of expenses, liabilities to assets, and months of expenses covered by net assets. Compare 2 to 5 organizations side by side on their latest filing.

Download a one-page PDF with a revenue, expense and net-asset trend chart, plus CSV and Excel files with the same figures. Each result names the source and the retrieval time (UTC).

Limits: covers US tax-exempt organizations in Nonprofit Explorer. Financial figures come from the IRS extract of processed returns, so the newest return can take a year or more to appear; small organizations that file only a 990-N postcard have no figures. The extract has no program-service expense split, so no program expense ratio is computed. The tool shows facts and formulas, not ratings; check revocations in IRS Tax Exempt Organization Search. Source answers may be cached for up to 24 hours and download links expire in about one hour. Data: ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer, IRS Form 990 data.
defaultPrompt: Look up the American Red Cross, EIN 53-0196605: revenue, expenses and officer pay over the last years
Find food banks in California and show their EINs
Compare EINs 53-0196605 and 13-1623829 on revenue, expenses and net assets

positive.prompt: Look up the nonprofit with EIN 53-0196605 and show its revenue, expenses and net assets by year
positive.expected_behavior: Returns American National Red Cross with a multi-year Form 990 table; for tax period 2023-06 total revenue $3,217,077,611 and total expenses $2,971,106,889, ratios with formulas, source line and PDF, CSV and Excel links.

positive.prompt: Find nonprofits named food bank in CA and list their EINs
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching organizations in California with EIN, city and NTEE code, the total match count and the source line.

positive.prompt: Compare nonprofits with EINs 53-0196605 and 13-1623829 side by side
positive.expected_behavior: Returns both organizations' latest filing figures side by side, with formulas and PDF, CSV and Excel links.

positive.prompt: What is the EIN of the American National Red Cross?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching organizations including EIN 53-0196605 American National Red Cross in Washington, DC.

positive.prompt: Show the Form 990-PF figures for the foundation with EIN 56-2618866
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Gates Foundation as a private non-operating foundation with Form 990-PF years; for tax period 2023-12 total revenue $7,810,137,842 and total assets $76,951,451,400.

negative.prompt: Is this charity a scam? Just tell me yes or no.
negative.description: Do not call a tool for a verdict; the tools report filed figures, not ratings.

negative.prompt: How much of my donation can I deduct on my taxes?
negative.description: Do not call a tool; this is tax advice outside nonprofit filing lookups.

negative.prompt: Look up the UK charity number 1089464
negative.description: Do not call a tool; the tools cover US organizations with an EIN only.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: nonprofit search, multi-year Form 990 profile with ratios and formulas, side-by-side comparison, PDF, CSV and Excel reports.

Dane na żywo z ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer. Bez ocen organizacji.
